mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails for a stale ratchet key or an overrun function: the createWorktree key is removed and the A6 Ratchet is empty. createWorktree is an orchestration over readExecutingTaskState (precondition read), createWorktreeBranch (Git outside the lock), recordWorktreeBaseCommit (the base-commit transaction, worktree removed on write failure) and provisionWorktree (worktree_provisioning.go), which serves the reuse and fresh paths. The guard runs inside make test at index 0.

TestOracleWtCreatePostWorktreeGaps/post_worktree_failed (json, human, state goldens) was committed alone (4b71fae3e) with goldens written from the unchanged production tree before any production edit; regen -mode check at index 4 reproduces it. The json golden records the unclassified internal error, the human golden the masked bounded diagnostic with the output-file digest tokenised. Making provisionWorktree ignore the post-worktree error turned the case red (exit 0, want 1) and restoring it returned green. wt-create success, not_executing and index_missing (W1-W3) and wt-delete (W4, W5) run live unchanged. Configured-language scip and functional-clusters refresh and Windows are recorded gaps (AC-gap).

Every existing worktree, post-worktree and index-refresh white-box test in internal/ops (wt_create_test.go, post_worktree_setup*_test.go, semble, scip, stacklit and functional-clusters tests) is unchanged and runs in the ops race at index 3. New: TestProvisionWorktreeRunsStepsInOrder (post-worktree command after the hook install and before the Semble ignore payload) and TestProvisionWorktreePostCmdFailureEndsSequence (nil warnings, *PostWorktreeSetupError, no later step; ignoring the error turned it red for that reason).

F6/F7 in the K-WT files: wt_create.go names the .claude config, settings, hooks and pre-commit file names, the directory and hook modes and the three warning prefixes; post_worktree_setup.go names the persisted outcome statuses (worktreeSetupOutcomeOK, worktreeSetupOutcomeFailed); values and bytes are unchanged, asserted by the unchanged ops white-box tests at index 3. F1/F2: wt_create.go, wt_delete.go and the K-WT files hold no history-event, anomaly-type or lifecycle-outcome literal. F8: post_worktree_cmd stays dynamic. F9: the scip-search, stacklit: and functional-clusters: warning prefixes are classified literal frozen data; the D-5-excluded functions are not edited.

TestOracleWtCreate and TestOracleWtDelete and every other delivered oracle run live in make test at index 0 against unchanged goldens; git shows no delivered oracle file or golden changed, only the new gap case was added.
The createWorktree key is removed in this commit and the A6 Ratchet is empty; the guard fails on a stale or overrun entry, so TestS1SizeGuard at index 0 proves both.

The test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and oracle suites at index 0; lint at index 1, test-e2e at index 2, the race run over ops, agent and commands at index 3 and the A6 regeneration check at index 4 are mandatory with it.
